summary: Galactic Ki Empire Phase 1 MVP — comprehensive backend + frontend testing. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases passed covering health, auth (valid/invalid/missing token), logout-deletes-session, bearer enforcement on all game endpoints, initial game state structure (5 buildings, all required fields), tap (single/multi/clamp 1-200), buy-building (insufficient ki 400, unknown building 400, single/bulk/partial-bulk purchase, 1.15x cost scaling), character level-up at 1000 ki with tap_power=1.5, idle earnings credited (8h cap, idle_gain/idle_seconds in response), leaderboard sorted by power_level desc with 'me' entry, no MongoDB _id leakage. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login screen renders title 'GALACTIC KI EMPIRE' with Sign-in-with-Google button and 3 feature pills; token injection via localStorage 'gki_session_token' works; home shows LV/PWR badges, ki balance, ki/sec, tap power, progress bar, tappable orb (5 taps increments ki to 5 and tap_count to 5); upgrades screen lists all 5 buildings with correct testIDs and BUILD/UPGRADE chips (bought training_dojo for 15 ki -> level 1, 0.2/s); alliance shows 'Coming Soon' with 4 feature teasers; leaderboard renders podium top-3 and ranked list with current user highlighted ('you' tag, blue border); profile shows avatar/name/email/Commander Level/4 stat boxes/achievements grid; logout button clears session and redirects to /login. All 5 bottom tabs reachable. No red screens, no console errors (only RN style deprecation warnings).

ui_bugs.issue: Sticky 'me' footer row visually overlaps with the last list row at the bottom of the screen (e.g. rank #10 sticky banner drawn on top of #8 list entry). Looks like an unintentional double-render where the floating 'you' card overlaps content above the tab bar.

issues: Numerous RN deprecation warnings in console: 'textShadow*' / 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use textShadow / boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents); Image style.resizeMode deprecated (use props.resizeMode). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up for SDK upgrades.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Fix leaderboard sticky 'me' footer so it does not visually overlap the list rows above it (consider adding bottom padding equal to footer height, or render 'me' only when off-screen).

(Cleanup, optional) Replace deprecated RN style props (textShadow* -> textShadow, shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents, Image style.resizeMode -> props.resizeMode) across login/home/upgrades/leaderboard/profile screens to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~550 lines and well-organized; consider splitting auth, game logic, and routes if it grows further.
compute_character_level loops one-by-one and is capped at 999 levels — fine for MVP but could be O(1) via logarithm if level inflation occurs.
buy-building bulk calc is correct but does not return per-level breakdown; current `purchased` + `spent` is adequate.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, home tap, upgrades buy, alliance, leaderboard, profile, logout all working; one minor visual overlap on leaderboard)

seed_data_creation: Created MongoDB user TEST_pytester@example.com (user_id auto-generated), seeded session token via /app/memory/test_credentials.md snippet. Per-test isolation uses dynamic TEST_<uuid>@example.com users via fresh_user fixture. A manually seeded session token (test_token_0b052e345feb4a5387ec7acb0d3ad7c0) for user tester@example.com / Test Hero was used for frontend testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_galactic_ki.py is reusable. It uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (read from /app/frontend/.env if missing in env). Seeds users with TEST_* prefix. Frontend auth bypass: write localStorage 'gki_session_token' with a JSON-stringified token string, then navigate to /. The Index page reads token, calls /api/auth/me, and routes to /(tabs)/home. Tab routes: /home /upgrades /alliance /leaderboard /profile. Key testIDs: login-screen, login-title, login-google-button, game-tappable-orb, upgrade-item-{training_dojo|spirit_generator|crystal_mine|energy_reactor|power_temple}-buy-button, profile-logout-button, splash-screen.
rca_of_issue: No bugs to RCA — Phase 1 MVP is functional end-to-end. The only visual nit is the leaderboard 'me' footer overlap, which is a layout/padding issue (sticky footer with absolute positioning while the list scrolls beneath it).
